title.zh: Physical Intelligence开放机器人模型API：采草莓、组装服务器，4天就能训练新动作
title.en: Physical Intelligence开放机器人模型API：采草莓、组装服务器，4天就能训练新动作

current_state.zh: Physical Intelligence launched a beta API that lets enterprises fine-tune its robot foundation models on Pi's cloud compute and control their robots via API, with partners demonstrating applications ranging from strawberry picking to server assembly and a dual-arm robot learning a new polishing task in four days.
